title: silaum tenuifolium
intro: Silaum tenuifolium, commonly known as Indian pennywort or Makoi, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. The health benefits of Silaum tenuifolium include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulator, which can help in reducing oxidative stress and improving overall health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine for various purposes such as wound healing, skin conditions, and as a nervine tonic. Silaum tenuifolium contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
